Flames' Joel Farabee: Stays hot with two points

findings.note: Oct. 2, 2026 RotoWire note: Luostarinen scored two goals, one on the power play, in a 4-3 OT loss to San Jose. It said he was on the third line but could get power-play time if Barkov's leg injury proved serious. Barkov's current status was not found.

Player page with RotoWire notes saying he was slated for the third line in 2026-27 and would likely return to a defensive middle-six role. He has topped 40 points only once. He had 33 points in 73 games last season, under one point per game.

Training-camp article saying he opened the season on a line with Anton Lundell. Coach Paul Maurice said he won't give up the hard defensive parts of the game to score more points. No injury, lineup or analyst pick for the Oct. 30 game against Winnipeg was found.

On Oct 18, 2026, Salomonsson came off non-roster injured reserve after shoulder surgery and was sent to AHL Manitoba without playing an NHL game this season. No recall was found, so it is unclear whether he will play tonight.

His 2025-26 NHL line was 1 goal, 4 assists and 5 points in 32 games, averaging 17:57 of ice time with one power-play assist. That is a low scoring rate for a depth defenseman, which fits the Under. ESPN's status fields conflict: this page shows him as OUT while his stats page shows Active.
In camp he was competing with right-handed defensemen Jack St. Ivany and Henry Thrun for a roster spot. If he plays, he is likely in a depth role, and he may be rusty after missing time for surgery.

Panthers preview (Oct 27): Florida's penalty kill was 25-for-26 since Oct. 13 and ranked seventh in the NHL. Winnipeg was also missing No. 1 defenseman Josh Morrissey (upper body, out since Oct. 7), which hurts the Jets' playmaking. Florida then beat Winnipeg 5-1 that night.

Jets gameday (Oct 27): line rushes had Scheifele centering the top line with Connor and Perfetti, so his role looks intact. But the Jets' power play was 0-for-12 over its previous four games, and the team was on a run of one-goal losses.

Covers matchup page for Oct 30: Florida is without goalie Jacob Markstrom (IR, upper body), Aleksander Barkov (LTIR, lower body) and Brad Marchand (leg, about four more weeks), so its lineup is short-handed. It lists Winnipeg at 4-6-3.

RotoWire item from Oct 27, 2026: Farabee had a goal and an assist against Toronto, giving him a five-game point streak (3G, 5A) and 11 points in 11 games, six of them on the power play. That works against an Under 0.5 assists bet. This search did not show his Oct 28 game at Edmonton.
